name: Steve Fonseca
body:
We had met at East, but I didn't really get to know him until we went to college together at UVM. I remember the first time I walked into his room, and he had sticky notes on everything with their Spanish word, I was so impressed at his dedication. He told me about how he was making and selling his own hummus, again, impressing me. Then we talked for hours about music and being a DJ. He introduced me to Afrobeat. We watched, Seven Samurai, together for the first time. He showed me a new way to roll joints. I will remember you always. 

I'm so glad I got to see him DJ, and so sad that I'll never see it again. RIP my brother.
